description: This file defines CLI commands for managing webhooks in Mattermost, including listing, creating, modifying, deleting, and showing webhooks, with command setup and handler functions.

classes.name: StoreResult[T any]
classes.description: Generic struct to hold data and error result for webhook operations.

methods.name: listWebhookCmdF
methods.description: Handles listing webhooks for specified or all teams.

methods.name: createIncomingWebhookCmdF
methods.description: Creates a new incoming webhook with specified parameters.

methods.name: modifyIncomingWebhookCmdF
methods.description: Modifies an existing incoming webhook identified by ID.

methods.name: createOutgoingWebhookCmdF
methods.description: Creates a new outgoing webhook with specified parameters.

methods.name: modifyOutgoingWebhookCmdF
methods.description: Modifies an existing outgoing webhook identified by ID.

methods.name: deleteWebhookCmdF
methods.description: Deletes a webhook by ID, whether incoming or outgoing.

methods.name: showWebhookCmdF
methods.description: Displays details of a webhook by ID.
